media.title: A Day at the Races (1937) — film poster
media.description: Promotional poster for A Day at the Races (1937), a Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer film represented in the Kaper database as Work W-F046 / Film F046. The image is sourced from Wikimedia Commons and has been treated as public domain in the United States under the pre-1978 no-notice rationale recorded there.
media.altText: Promotional poster for the MGM film A Day at the Races (1937).
media.rightsNote: Wikimedia Commons marks this poster as public domain in the United States because it was published in the United States between 1931 and 1977 without a copyright notice; the file page records a pre-1978 no-mark rationale and notes visible Tooker/Litho markings. Commons notes that copyright may still subsist in some non-US jurisdictions.
media.publicCaption: Poster for A Day at the Races (MGM, 1937).
media.publicImageText: The image shows a film poster for A Day at the Races, with Marx Brothers promotional artwork, MGM branding and title billing.
